remarks: Welcome to 133 Lansdowne; a fantastic, "sun-drenched", renovated 2 bedroom 2 full bath end unit with only 1 STEP to access the house & bedrooms! Sought after gated community with spectacular grounds including a gazebo, sprawling green lawns, a community pool & tennis/pickleball courts. Amazing, fully renovated, eat in kitchen with breakfast bar, beautiful white, Krion Solid Surface, counters, Bosch stainless steel appliances & soft close custom cabinetry. Living room features cathedral ceiling, skylights & refaced fireplace. Newer engineered hardwood floors in LR, EIK & foyer. Inviting 3 season room overlooking well manicured backyard. Primary bedroom & 2nd bedroom located on the main level! Loft for additional living space. Updated 2 full baths. A front & back patio. Central Air. 1 car detached garage. Convenient Westport location close to shopping. Must See! Qtrly District Tax = $1,545.46
